api_dockerfile.content:
# Build stage
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0 AS build
WORKDIR /src

# Copy csproj files and restore
COPY ["src/JIR.Domain/JIR.Domain.csproj", "src/JIR.Domain/"]
COPY ["src/JIR.Application/JIR.Application.csproj", "src/JIR.Application/"]
COPY ["src/JIR.Infrastructure/JIR.Infrastructure.csproj", "src/JIR.Infrastructure/"]
COPY ["src/JIR.WebAPI/JIR.WebAPI.csproj", "src/JIR.WebAPI/"]
RUN dotnet restore "src/JIR.WebAPI/JIR.WebAPI.csproj"

# Copy everything else and build
COPY . .
WORKDIR "/src/src/JIR.WebAPI"
RUN dotnet build "JIR.WebAPI.csproj" -c Release -o /app/build

# Publish stage
FROM build AS publish
RUN dotnet publish "JIR.WebAPI.csproj" -c Release -o /app/publish /p:UseAppHost=false

# Runtime stage
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/aspnet:9.0 AS final
WORKDIR /app
EXPOSE 8080
EXPOSE 8081
COPY --from=publish /app/publish .
ENTRYPOINT ["dotnet", "JIR.WebAPI.dll"]

blazor_dockerfile.content:
# Build stage
FROM mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:9.0 AS build
WORKDIR /src

COPY ["src/JIR.BlazorApp/JIR.BlazorApp.csproj", "src/JIR.BlazorApp/"]
RUN dotnet restore "src/JIR.BlazorApp/JIR.BlazorApp.csproj"

COPY . .
WORKDIR "/src/src/JIR.BlazorApp"
RUN dotnet build "JIR.BlazorApp.csproj" -c Release -o /app/build

# Publish stage
FROM build AS publish
RUN dotnet publish "JIR.BlazorApp.csproj" -c Release -o /app/publish /p:UseAppHost=false

# Runtime stage (NGINX to serve static files)
FROM nginx:alpine AS final
WORKDIR /usr/share/nginx/html
COPY --from=publish /app/publish/wwwroot .
COPY src/JIR.BlazorApp/nginx.conf /etc/nginx/nginx.conf
EXPOSE 80

env_example.content:
# Database
DB_USER=jir_admin
DB_PASSWORD=CHANGE_ME_STRONG_PASSWORD
DB_NAME=jir_finance

# PgAdmin
PGADMIN_EMAIL=admin@jir.local
PGADMIN_PASSWORD=CHANGE_ME_ADMIN_PASSWORD

# ASP.NET Core
ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Development

# JWT
JWT_SECRET=YOUR_SUPER_SECRET_KEY_MIN_32_CHARACTERS_LONG_HERE
JWT_ISSUER=JIR.WebAPI
JWT_AUDIENCE=JIR.BlazorApp

# API URL (for Blazor)
API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:5000

init_script.content:
# Initialize JIR Project
Write-Host "🚀 Initialisation du projet JIR..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Check Docker
if (!(Get-Command docker -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) {
  Write-Host "❌ Docker n'est pas installé. Installez Docker Desktop." -ForegroundColor Red
  exit 1
}

# Copy .env.example to .env if not exists
if (!(Test-Path ".env")) {
  Copy-Item ".env.example" ".env"
  Write-Host "✅ Fichier .env créé. Configurez vos variables d'environnement." -ForegroundColor Green
} else {
  Write-Host "⚠️  Le fichier .env existe déjà." -ForegroundColor Yellow
}

# Build Docker images
Write-Host "📦 Build des images Docker..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
docker-compose build

# Start containers
Write-Host "🚀 Démarrage des conteneurs..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
docker-compose up -d

# Wait for PostgreSQL
Write-Host "⏳ Attente de PostgreSQL..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
Start-Sleep -Seconds 10

# Run migrations
Write-Host "🔧 Exécution des migrations EF Core..." -ForegroundColor Cyan
docker-compose exec api dotnet ef database update

Write-Host ""
Write-Host "✅ Projet initialisé avec succès!" -ForegroundColor Green
Write-Host "📱 Blazor App: http://localhost:5001" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "🔌 API: http://localhost:5000" -ForegroundColor Cyan
Write-Host "🗄️  PgAdmin: http://localhost:5050" -ForegroundColor Cyan

deploy_script.content:
param(
  [string]$Environment = "staging",
  [string]$Version = "latest"
)

Write-Host "🚀 Déploiement en environnement: $Environment" -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Pull latest code
git pull origin main

# Build new images with version tag
docker-compose build
docker tag jir_api:latest jir_api:$Version
docker tag jir_blazor:latest jir_blazor:$Version

# Stop current containers
docker-compose down

# Start new containers
docker-compose up -d

# Run migrations
docker-compose exec api dotnet ef database update

Write-Host "✅ Déploiement terminé!" -ForegroundColor Green

backup_script.content:
$BackupDate = Get-Date -Format "yyyyMMdd_HHmmss"
$BackupFile = "backups/jir_backup_$BackupDate.sql"

Write-Host "💾 Sauvegarde de la base de données..." -ForegroundColor Cyan

# Create backups folder
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path "backups" | Out-Null

# Backup using pg_dump
docker-compose exec -T postgres pg_dump -U jir_admin jir_finance > $BackupFile

Write-Host "✅ Sauvegarde créée: $BackupFile" -ForegroundColor Green

github_actions.content:
name: CI/CD Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main, develop]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Setup .NET
      uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
      with:
        dotnet-version: '9.0.x'
    
    - name: Restore dependencies
      run: dotnet restore
    
    - name: Build
      run: dotnet build --no-restore --configuration Release
    
    - name: Run tests
      run: dotnet test --no-build --configuration Release --verbosity normal
    
    - name: Build Docker images
      run: docker-compose build
    
    - name: Run Docker Compose
      run: docker-compose up -d
    
    - name: Health check
      run: |
        sleep 30
        curl -f http://localhost:5000/health || exit 1
    
    - name: Stop containers
      run: docker-compose down

  deploy:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    
    steps:
    - uses: actions/checkout@v4
    
    - name: Deploy to production
      run: |
        # Add your deployment commands here
        echo "Deploying to production..."
